o.text: Internationalism. Borrowed from Russian рестора́н (restorán), ultimately from French restaurant.
Borrowed from Arabic تَخْمِينًا (taḵmīnan), adverbial accusative of تَخْمِين (taḵmīn). By surface analysis, təxmin + -ən.
Possibly from hədə gəlmək (“to threaten”), semi-calqued from Persian [script needed] (hadhada raftan, “to terrify, frighten, threaten”). Compare Armenian հաթաթա (hatʻatʻa).
Borrowed from Russian кла́виша (kláviša), ultimately from Latin clāvis.
